15. (Currently amended) A method for selecting a first server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of:

__at least temporarily storing the information added to the locator on the second server computer;__
selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator; and
__providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of a hyperlink by the client computer.__
